title: 4am Recall
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: A wistful, chord-led UK garage track built around chopped vocal stabs and a swung 2-step RolandTR707 kit that breathes like a late-night dancefloor memory. Lush minor seventh progressions swell and recede across a continuous journey from sparse opener to euphoric peak and back to hazy close. Fred Again emotional grain meets Joy Orbison's percussive precision throughout.
